if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then echo "usage: render.sh <url-or-file> <out-dir>" >&2; exit 2; fi
target="$1"
output="$2"
mkdir -p "$output"
if [[ -f "$target" ]]; then target="file://$(cd "$(dirname "$target")" && pwd)/$(basename "$target")"; fi
node "$(dirname "$0")/render-playwright.mjs" "$target" "$output"
